articles.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
articles.snippet: While the FBI listed hundreds of addresses in its notice, Chainalysis said the Binance attackers have already used "thousands addresses," and expects this number to continue growing.

articles.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach
articles.snippet: Binance is absorbing all losses through corporate funds, futures reserves, and SAFU, keeping user balances intact.

articles.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
articles.snippet: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.

articles.title: Texas brothers sentenced to 15 years in prison for armed crypto robbery, kidnapping
articles.snippet: Home invasions became the most common form of crypto wrench attacks worldwide during the first half of 2026, rising to 20 incidents from one.

articles.title: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen
articles.snippet: Attackers raced to convert stolen stablecoins into crypto that issuers could not freeze as industry players like Tether and Circle moved to immobilize billions of dollars in assets.
